title: PERIPH_EN
description: Peripheral enables: clock-out routing, GNSS reset, GNSS standby.

title: txant_post
description: Number of samples to delay turning off the internal TDD signal.

title: tx_tst_i
description: TX test value for I channel.

title: tx_tst_q
description: TX test value for Q channel.

title: board_id
description: Board identification number, read only (LimeSDR USB default 0x0011).

title: board_ver_ctrl
description: Board version/BOM control. Documented quirk: firmware currently always returns a fixed 0x0002, regardless of actual hardware/BOM version.
TRXIQ pulse mode. Only bit exposed by firmware on both read and write; other reg08 bits are not accessible through this legacy register.
Manual value of external TDD signal.
Control external TDD signal by internal TDD signal.
Control RF switches by internal TDD signal.

title: txant_pre
description: Number of samples to delay turning on the internal TDD signal.

title: txant_post
description: Number of samples to delay turning off the internal TDD signal.

title: lms1
description: LMS1 hardware reset. Board-specific: this register is write-only in the current firmware, no read-back case is implemented.

title: lb_out_override
description: RF loopback TX1 path enable (drives complementary TX1_L/TX1_H switch outputs). Board-specific: writing this register also force-enables the override for all loopback outputs.
RF loopback TX2 path enable (drives complementary TX2_L/TX2_H switch outputs).

title: reg18
description: Board-specific control register; not further decoded by firmware.

title: c1_phase
description: Phase value for PLL output clock 1.
PLL configuration error, read only. Board-specific: added in addition to the common status bits.

title: pll_lock
description: PLL lock status (single PLL on this board).

title: pllcfg_vcodiv
description: PLL VCO division value. Board-specific: only this bit is wired; loop-filter/charge-pump bits used on other boards are not implemented.
C4 counter odd-division enable. Board-specific: this board's PLL reconfiguration block has 5 output counters (C0..C4), unlike the 8-counter block used on other boards.

title: phcfg_samples
description: Number of samples to compare during automatic phase configuration.

title: phcfg_step
description: Step size used during automatic phase configuration.

title: test_frc_err
description: Insert error into FX3 PCLK test.
Insert error into ADF4002 phase-detector test.
Insert error into DDR2_1 memory test.
Insert error into DDR2_2 memory test.

title: si5351c_clk7_cnt
description: Si5351C CLK7 counter value. Board-specific: SI5351C counters are addressed in descending order (0x6A=CLK7 .. 0x71=CLK0) on this board, unlike the ascending order used on other boards.

title: ddr2_1_pnf_per_bit_l
description: DDR2_1 data [15:0] pass/fail-per-bit result. Board-specific: LimeSDR-USB has WFM-player-driven DDR2 self-test registers not present on other boards.

title: board_gpio_dir
description: GPIO direction bits for FPGA_GPIO[7:0]. Board-specific: firmware inverts this legacy 1=output convention before writing it to the underlying gpio_io CSR, whose own convention is 0=output.

title: board_gpio_val
description: GPIO output value bits for FPGA_GPIO[7:0].
